title: Govee's smart nugget ice maker makes every iced drink feel like a luxury | TechCrunch
summary: Govee says that the modern-design gadget delivers nugget ice in as little as six minutes. The ice maker also supports voice commands with Alexa and Google Assistant, which means a quick ““Hey Google, start the ice maker,” leads to fresh ice.
